## get_test_case

Get detailed information about a specific test case

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key (e.g., PROJ-T123) |

## create_test_case

Create a new test case with STEP_BY_STEP, PLAIN_TEXT, or BDD content. To match your project's structure, use the zephyr://testcase/EXISTING-KEY resource to fetch a real test case and use its structure as a template, especially for custom_fields.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (required) |
| `name` | string | yes | Test case name (required) |
| `test_script` | object |  | Test script object containing type and content |
| `folder` | string |  | Folder path (optional, e.g., "/Orbiter/Cargo Bay") |
| `status` | string |  | Test case status (optional, default: "Draft"). Value must match a status name configured in your Zephyr project (e.g. "Draft", "Approved", "Deprecated"). Note: always overridden to "Draft" on creation. |
| `priority` | string |  | Test case priority (optional). Value must match a priority name configured in your Zephyr project (e.g. "High", "Normal", "Low", "Critical"). Use zephyr://testcase/EXISTING-KEY to check your project's valid values. |
| `precondition` | string |  | Test precondition (optional) |
| `objective` | string |  | Test objective (optional) |
| `component_id` | integer |  | Jira component ID (optional, Cloud only — use the numeric component ID, not the name) |
| `owner_id` | string |  | Test case owner Jira Account ID (optional, Cloud only — e.g. "5b10a2844c20165700ede21g") |
| `estimated_time` | number |  | Estimated time in milliseconds (optional) |
| `labels` | string[] |  | Array of labels (optional) |
| `issue_links` | string[] |  | Array of Jira issue keys to link to this test case (e.g. ["PROJ-123", "PROJ-456"]). On Cloud, each key is resolved to a numeric Jira issue ID via the Jira REST API, then linked via POST /testcases/{key}/links/issues — failures are reported as warnings but do not fail the tool call. On Data Center, sent directly in the create payload. |
| `custom_fields` | object |  | Custom fields object (optional). Use the zephyr://testcase/EXISTING-KEY resource to fetch a real test case and copy its customFields structure. Common examples: {"Type": "Functional", "Priority": "P2", "Regression": false, "Execution Type": "Manual - To Be Automated", "Risk Control": false} |
| `parameters` | object |  | Test parameters for data-driven testing (optional) |

## update_test_case_bdd

Update an existing test case with BDD content. Optionally update the test case name. Unspecified fields are preserved.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to update |
| `name` | string |  | New test case name (optional) |
| `bdd_content` | string | yes | BDD content in markdown format (will be converted to Gherkin when possible) |

## update_test_case_custom_fields

Update one or more custom field values on an existing test case. Merges the given fields into the existing customFields object — fields not mentioned are left untouched. Use the zephyr://testcase/EXISTING-KEY resource to see current custom field names/values.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to update |
| `custom_fields` | object | yes | Custom field name/value pairs to set. Only the keys provided are changed; existing custom fields not mentioned here are preserved. Example: {"Risk Control": true, "Execution Type": "Manual - To Be Automated"} |

## move_test_case_folder

Move an existing test case to a different folder. The destination folder must already exist (use create_folder first if needed). All other fields on the test case are preserved.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to move |
| `folder` | string | yes | Full destination folder path (e.g., "/Parent/Child"). Must already exist. |

## update_test_case_name

Rename an existing test case. All other fields on the test case are preserved.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to rename |
| `name` | string | yes | New test case name |

## update_test_case_precondition_objective

Update the precondition and/or objective on an existing test case. Provide at least one of precondition/objective; the other is preserved if omitted. All other fields on the test case are preserved.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to update |
| `precondition` | string |  | New precondition text (optional) |
| `objective` | string |  | New objective text (optional) |

## create_folder

Create a new folder in Zephyr Scale. On Cloud: provide a path like "/Parent/Child" — the server resolves parent segments and creates the leaf folder. On Data Center: the full path is sent directly.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (required) |
| `name` | string | yes | Full folder path including parent folders (required). Examples: "/MyFolder" for root folder, "/Parent/Child" for nested folder. On Cloud, individual segment names must not contain "/" or "\". |
| `folder_type` | `TEST_CASE` \\| `TEST_PLAN` \\| `TEST_CYCLE` |  | Type of folder |

## get_folders

Get folders from Zephyr Scale. All parameters are optional. If folder_path is provided, returns the full subtree (the folder and all its descendants at every depth) under that path. Otherwise returns all folders matching the filters.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string |  | Jira project key filter (e.g., "PROJ"). Optional. |
| `folder_type` | `TEST_CASE` \\| `TEST_PLAN` \\| `TEST_CYCLE` |  | Folder type filter (optional) |
| `folder_path` | string |  | Folder path to filter by (e.g., "/CRM on Wechat"). Returns the matching folder and all folders nested beneath it at any depth. Requires project_key and folder_type to resolve the path. |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum total number of folders to return (optional). Defaults to all folders. |

## create_test_run

Create a new test run

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (required) |
| `name` | string | yes | Test run name (required) |
| `test_case_keys` | string[] |  | Array of test case keys to include in the test run |
| `test_plan_key` | string |  | Test plan key to link this test run to (optional) |
| `folder` | string |  | Folder path (optional) |
| `planned_start_date` | string |  | Planned start date in ISO format (optional) |
| `planned_end_date` | string |  | Planned end date in ISO format (optional) |
| `description` | string |  | Test run description (optional) |
| `owner` | string |  | Test run owner (optional) |
| `environment` | string |  | Test environment name (optional). On Cloud, applied to each test execution (environmentName). On Data Center, set at cycle level. |
| `issue_key` | string |  | Single Jira issue key to link to the test cycle (e.g. "PROJ-123"). On Cloud, resolved to a numeric ID via Jira REST API — requires JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN env vars. |
| `issue_links` | string[] |  | Array of Jira issue keys to link to the test cycle (e.g. ["PROJ-123", "PROJ-456"]). On Cloud, each key is resolved to a numeric ID via Jira REST API — requires JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN env vars. Failures are reported as warnings and do not fail the tool call. |
| `jira_project_version` | integer |  | Jira project version/release ID to link this test cycle to (optional, Cloud only — use the numeric version ID). |
| `custom_fields` | object |  | Custom fields object (optional) |

## get_test_run

Get detailed information about a specific test run

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_run_key` | string | yes | Test run key (e.g., PROJ-R123) |

## get_test_execution

Get detailed information about a specific test execution by ID or key. On Cloud, provide the execution ID or key (e.g., PROJ-E123) directly. On Data Center, also provide test_run_keys to search within.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `execution_id` | string | yes | Test execution ID or key (e.g., 5805255 or PROJ-E123) |
| `test_run_keys` | string[] |  | Array of test run keys to search in (required for Data Center, optional for Cloud — e.g., ["PROJ-R152", "PROJ-R161"]) |

## search_test_cases_by_folder

Search for test cases in a specific folder

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (e.g., PROJ) |
| `folder_path` | string | yes | Folder path to search in (e.g., /ProjectName/SubFolder) |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of results to return (optional, default 100) |

## search_test_cases

Search for test cases by name (case-insensitive substring match) within a project, optionally scoped to an exact folder. Neither Cloud nor Data Center support server-side name search, so this paginates/queries then filters client-side, capped at 5000 scanned test cases per call — check "truncated" in the response if you need exhaustive results on a very large project.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (e.g., PROJ) |
| `name_contains` | string | yes | Case-insensitive substring to match against test case names (e.g., "login") |
| `folder_path` | string |  | Optional exact folder path to scope the search to (e.g., /ProjectName/SubFolder). Does not include subfolders. |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of matching test cases to return (optional, default 100) |

## search_test_runs

Search for test runs using a query. Supports filtering by projectKey and/or folder path. On Cloud, only returns cycles in the exact folder (not sub-folders). Use folder_id for direct numeric ID lookup (skips path resolution).

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string |  | Project key to filter by (e.g., "PROJ"). Can be a single key or omitted if using folder only. |
| `folder` | string |  | Folder path to filter test runs by (e.g., "/MyFolder/SubFolder"). Resolved to a numeric folderId on Cloud. |
| `folder_id` | number |  | Numeric folder ID to filter test runs by (optional). If provided, takes precedence over folder path and skips path resolution. Use this when you already know the folder ID. |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of results to return (optional, default 200) |
| `fields` | string |  | Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (optional, e.g., "key,name,status,folder"). If not set, all fields are returned. |

## list_executions_by_cycle

List all test executions for a specific test cycle. Returns execution status, executedBy, actualEndDate for each test case in the cycle. Works on Cloud (/testexecutions) and Data Center (/testrun/{key}/testresults).

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_cycle_key` | string | yes | Test cycle key (e.g., DDCN-R371) |
| `project_key` | string | yes | Project key (required for Cloud) |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of results to return (optional, default 100) |

## update_test_run

Update an existing test cycle — set owner, name, description, dates, or status. Unspecified fields are preserved. Cloud only.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_run_key` | string | yes | Test cycle key to update (e.g., PROJ-R123) |
| `owner` | string |  | Jira Account ID of the new owner (e.g., "6269ee89494f17007056d8f0") |
| `name` | string |  | New name for the test cycle (optional) |
| `description` | string |  | New description (optional) |
| `planned_start_date` | string |  | Planned start date in ISO format (optional) |
| `planned_end_date` | string |  | Planned end date in ISO format (optional) |
| `status_id` | number |  | Numeric status ID to set (optional) |

## update_test_execution

Update a test case execution's status within a test cycle, and optionally attach bug(s) as Jira issue links. Identify the execution either by execution_id directly, or by test_cycle_key + test_case_key (the latest execution is used). Cloud only.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `execution_id` | string |  | Test execution key or ID (e.g. "PROJ-E123" or 5805255). Takes precedence over test_cycle_key/test_case_key. |
| `test_cycle_key` | string |  | Test cycle key (e.g. "PROJ-R123"). Used together with test_case_key to locate the execution when execution_id is not given. |
| `test_case_key` | string |  | Test case key (e.g. "PROJ-T456"). Used together with test_cycle_key to locate the execution. |
| `project_key` | string |  | Project key for the cycle lookup (optional — derived from test_cycle_key when omitted). |
| `status` | string |  | New execution status name. Common values: "Pass", "Fail", "In Progress", "Blocked", "Not Executed". Must match a status configured in your Zephyr project. |
| `comment` | string |  | Comment against the overall execution (e.g. failure details). |
| `environment` | string |  | Environment name assigned to the execution (e.g. "Chrome Latest Version"). |
| `execution_time` | number |  | Actual execution time in milliseconds (optional). |
| `actual_end_date` | string |  | Actual end date in ISO format, e.g. "2024-05-20T13:15:13Z" (optional). |
| `executed_by_id` | string |  | Jira Account ID of the user who executed the test (optional). |
| `assigned_to_id` | string |  | Jira Account ID of the user the execution is assigned to (optional). |
| `bug_keys` | string[] |  | Jira issue keys to attach to the execution as bugs (e.g. ["PROJ-789"]). Each key is resolved to a numeric ID via the Jira REST API (requires JIRA_USERNAME + JIRA_API_TOKEN) and linked via POST /testexecutions/{key}/links/issues. Failures are reported as warnings and do not fail the call. |

## get_test_cycles_for_issue

Get the Zephyr test cycles linked to a Jira issue (e.g. a story or epic). Calls GET /issuelinks/{issueKey}/testcycles and, by default, resolves each numeric cycle ID to its key (e.g. "PROJ-R123") and name. Use this to discover the test cycle referenced by a Jira ticket, then feed the key into list_executions_by_cycle / update_test_execution. Cloud only.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issue_key` | string | yes | Jira issue key whose linked test cycles to fetch (e.g. "PROJ-123"). |
| `resolve_keys` | boolean |  | When true (default), resolve each cycle ID to its key + name via GET /testcycles/{id}. Set false to return raw numeric IDs only (faster, no extra calls). |

## delete_test_run

Delete a specific test run (Data Center only — not supported on Cloud v2)

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_run_key` | string | yes | Test run key to delete (e.g., PROJ-R123) |

## add_test_cases_to_run

Add test cases to an existing test run (Cloud only — not supported on Data Center)

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_run_key` | string | yes | Test run key (e.g., PROJ-R161) |
| `test_case_keys` | string[] | yes | Array of test case keys to add to the test run |

## get_test_case_steps

Get the test steps for a specific test case (Cloud only). Returns the raw paginated API response including values, total, startAt, and maxResults fields.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key (e.g., QA-T123) |
| `start_at` | integer |  | Zero-based page offset (default 0) |
| `max_results` | integer |  | Page size between 1 and 100 (default 100) |

## update_test_case_steps

Write STEP_BY_STEP test steps to an existing test case (Cloud only). Use mode APPEND to add steps without destroying existing ones, or OVERWRITE to replace all steps.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key to update (e.g., QA-T123) |
| `steps` | object[] | yes | Steps to write. Each step is either an inline step (description required; testData and expectedResult optional) or a call-to-test reference (testCaseKey only — mutually exclusive with inline fields). |
| `mode` | `APPEND` \\| `OVERWRITE` |  | Write mode. APPEND (default) adds to existing steps. OVERWRITE replaces all existing steps. |

## get_projects

Get Zephyr projects. If project_key_or_id is provided, fetches that single project instead of listing all projects. (Cloud only)

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key_or_id` | string |  | Zephyr project ID or Jira project key (e.g., "PROJ"). When given, returns a single project instead of a paginated list. |
| `start_at` | number |  | Zero-indexed starting position for pagination. Ignored when project_key_or_id is given. Default 0. |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of results to return, up to 1000. Ignored when project_key_or_id is given. Default 200. |

## get_statuses

Get statuses for test cases, test plans, test cycles, or test executions from Zephyr Scale. (Cloud only)

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_key` | string |  | Jira project key filter (e.g., "PROJ"). Optional. |
| `status_type` | `TEST_CASE` \\| `TEST_PLAN` \\| `TEST_CYCLE` \\| `TEST_EXECUTION` |  | Filter statuses by the entity type they belong to. Optional. |
| `start_at` | number |  | Zero-indexed starting position for pagination. Default 0. |
| `max_results` | number |  | Maximum number of results to return, up to 1000. Default 200. |

Get environments from Zephyr Scale. (Cloud only)

## get_test_script

Get the test script (PLAIN_TEXT or BDD content) for a specific test case. Zephyr stores BDD/plain-text test content under the test script resource, separate from STEP_BY_STEP steps — use get_test_case_steps instead for STEP_BY_STEP test cases. Works on Cloud and Data Center.

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_case_key` | string | yes | Test case key (e.g., PROJ-T123) |

| Arg | Type | Req | Description |

| `issue_key` | string | yes | Jira issue key (e.g., PROJ-123) |
